President Donald Trump’s approval rating is underwater in nearly all states with competitive Senate races in the 2026 midterm elections, according to the latest polling data from Civiqs. [...] ### Maine

The Maine Senate race is expected to be one of the closest of the 2026 midterms, as Republican Senator Susan Collins is running against Democrat Troy Jackson, the former Maine Senate president.
